Package org.bsc.langgraph4j.agui.sdk

package org.bsc.langgraph4j.agui.sdk
  • Class
    Description
    AGUIAgent
    Represents an agent compliant with the AG-UI protocol, capable of running against a RunAgentInput and streaming back a reactive sequence of Events.
    AGUIAgentBase
    Base implementation of AGUIAgent that bridges a langgraph4j CompiledGraph execution with the AG-UI protocol event stream.
    AGUIAgentRegistry
    A registry of AGUIAgent instances, keyed by their id.
    AGUIHook
    LangGraph4j NodeHook implementation dedicated to the AG-UI protocol.
    AGUINodeOutput<State extends AgentState>
    Custom LangGraph4j NodeOutput implementation that acts as a bridge between the LangGraph4j output streaming and the AG-UI event model.
    AGUINodeOutput.Builder
    Builder for AGUINodeOutput instances, used to accumulate the AG-UI Events to be carried by the resulting output before binding them to a node id and state via AGUINodeOutput.Builder.build(String, AgentState).
    AGUIRunAgentInput
     
    AGUISSEController
    Spring Boot controller exposing a Server-Sent Events (SSE) endpoint compliant with the AG-UI protocol, driving the lifecycle of a registered LangGraph4j AGUIAgent.
